title: strip_trailing_dot uses byte slice instead of strip_suffix
description: kith-tslocal strip_trailing_dot does s[..s.len() - 1] after checking ends_with('.'). A dot is a single ASCII byte so this is correct, but s.strip_suffix('.').unwrap_or(&s) is the idiomatic form that makes the intent unambiguous. The current pattern is a known footgun for multibyte chars even though it cannot go wrong with '.'. Replace to eliminate reviewer questions.
